newsitem.title: USA: Elscint blames Q1 loss on strong dollar.
newsitem.headline: Elscint blames Q1 loss on strong dollar.

text.p: Elscint Ltd of Haifa, Israel, on Tuesday blamed a first quarter loss on currency exchange problems from the need to translate various currencies into U.S. dollars.
Elscint reported a first-quarter loss of $0.05 per share, compared with a profit of $0.16 per share for the same quarter a year ago.
Elscint had an operating profit of $1.3 million for the first quarter, down from $2.9 million for the same period in 1996. The company attributed the decline to a decrease in net sales.
Elscint is a medical imaging company.
